purpose: Resolve only current-source fields required by the already-frozen materialization contract before any Y2/Y3 current-player output is generated.

exact_age_completion.rule: Replace only the 35 previously-null 2026 age_years values by exact player+position match. Do not modify any other Y1 field.

experience_completion.standard: For mapped players use 2026 experience from the governed historical panel: 2026-entry_season_used, equivalently the latest governed experience plus elapsed seasons.
experience_completion.deterministic_fallback_for_two_no_panel_: The approved provider identity snapshot proves both are on the governed 2025 NFL roster. With no earlier governed panel history, set first_observed/entry season to 2025 solely for the experience feature, giving experience=1 for the 2026 source season.
experience_completion.unmatched_rule: experience=0; prior-history coverage=0; no projection is substituted as observed NFL history.

prior_history.prior1: Coverage=1 only with a genuine 2025 Phase-2 player-season row; otherwise 0.
prior_history.prior2: Coverage=1 only when genuine 2025 and 2024 PIT age/state residuals are both available; otherwise 0.
prior_history.qb_memory: Use genuine 2025 PIT age/state residual only where available; otherwise missing/neutral with coverage=0.
prior_history.missing_role_usage: If no genuine 2025 row, role=unknown and opportunity/games missing.
